in_hebrew.name: ג'ספרינה
in_hebrew.meaning: אבן יסמין, מעין אבן חצי יקרה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ג'ספרינה מקורו באבן יסמין, שהיא אבן חצי יקרה המוזכרת בספר יחזקאל, פרק כח, פסוק כב, ובספר שמות, פרק כח, פסוק כ. היא מסמלת את האבן היקרה והנערצה, המייצגת את היופי והערך הרוחני.

in_greek.name: Γιασπερίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Γιασπερίνη προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν ἴασπις, μιά ἡμιπολύτιμη λίθο, ποὺ ἀναφέρεται στο Βιβλίο τοῦ Ἰηζεκιήλ, κεφάλαιο 28, εὐαγγέλιο 22, καὶ στὸ Βιβλίο τῆς Ἐξόδου, κεφάλαιο 28, εὐαγγέλιο 20. Συμβολίζει τὴν πολύτιμη καὶ θαυμαστή λίθο, ποὺ εἶναι σύμβολο τῆς πνευματικῆς ἀξίας καὶ τοῦ κάλλους.

in_latin.name: Jasperina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jasperina derivatur a lapide iaspide, qui est gemma semipretiosa, quae commemoratur in libro Ezechielis, capitulo 28, versiculo 22, et in libro Exodi, capitulo 28, versiculo 20. Significat lapidem pretiosum et admirandum, qui est symbolum spiritualis valoris et pulchritudinis.

in_english.name: Jasperina
in_english.meaning: Jasperina means 'treasurer' or 'keeper of the treasure'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jasperina originates from the Hebrew word 'yashpeh', meaning 'treasurer' or 'keeper of the treasure'. It is associated with the gemstone jasper, a type of chalcedony, which is mentioned in the Bible (Ezekiel 28:22 and Exodus 28:20). In Christian tradition, Jasperina symbolizes spiritual wealth, inner beauty, and devotion. The name represents a person of great value, wisdom, and spiritual richness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jasperina carries a sense of reverence and valuing. It conveys a deep appreciation for the individual, as if they are a precious gem or treasure. This can lead to a positive self-image and greater self-worth.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Bible, Jasper is one of the precious stones in the foundation of the New Jerusalem. This stone is associated with the tribes of Judah and Dan. Jasper is described as being clear as crystal and having a bright, beautiful splendor. The spiritual significance of the name Jasperina, therefore, is that it represents the treasured child of God who reflects God's light and beauty in the world. It also serves as a reminder of the value of faith and the preciousness of God's love.
